title: DTN rate limiter keys on iid7 single byte (deaddrop + confessions): IID collisions starve honest nodes
description: Edge/security review finding on eliz (pattern pre-existing in the deaddrop path, repeated in the new confessions code): per-node rate state keys on peer_eui64[7] (256 buckets) — honest nodes with colliding low-byte IIDs share a bucket (mutual starvation), and a fabricating source can grind buckets to bypass the hourly cap. Spec 18.10.3 says per-node IID. Fix direction: key on the full 8-byte IID (hash or direct map) in both handlers; bounded memory per constrained targets.
